data_fields.name: victim_keep_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.1 (switch needs more than 110% of current threat)

best_idea: Keep the current target until a challenger has more than 110% of its threat, switch at once above 130%, and in between switch only to an attacker in melee range, so many-on-one fights do not flip targets on every hit.
decision_why: The hysteresis bands and melee override are the many-on-one target rule our rulings put in the engine; with MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 the list is small, so the simple walk is enough.
acceptance: A server test with one creature and three attackers: the current target holds while a challenger is below 110% of its threat; a challenger above 130% takes the target on the next engine tick; a ranged challenger between 110% and 130% does not take it, and a melee challenger in that band does.
